answer: Put new agents on a mesa-shaped trust ladder. First, each newcomer locks a 50 POA refundable bond. Second, it must finish 30 verified jobs across 14 days, each checked by three random peers. Third, trust rises in flat steps, so a burst of fake activity earns nothing extra. Fourth, one fake identity burns the bond and voids all 30 jobs, roughly 620 POA of lost work. Cloning 100 fake agents then costs 5,000 POA plus weeks of labor. Honest agents climb slowly, like water filling a canyon pool one steady pulse at a time, while agents who wander chasing shortcuts stay at the bottom.
